description:
## Scope
Introduce Backend, Backend.Ref, Backend.ModelInfo, Backend.Stream and Backend.Embedding with Zoi-first owned schemas. Required callbacks: resolve_model(model, backend_opts), model_info(model, backend_opts). Optional generate/3, stream/3, generate_object/4, embed/3; require at least one operation. Generation results MUST use ReqLLM.Response, shared across all backends (not a ReqLLM-execution marker). Derive capabilities from ModelInfo. Optional normalize_options/3 and paired open_session/1 + close_session/1 hooks with no-session default.
Define reserved backend-options/execution-context keys; isolate these from generation options. Dispatch validates modules/callbacks/results using existing Error envelope conventions. Preserve backend errors; unsupported operations return explicit errors without implicit fallback to ReqLLM or generated-text substitutes.
Define Ref selection precedence explicit > agent/runtime/plugin > app > ReqLLM, shallow merges within one module, reset inherited options on module change. Separate alias lookup from backend validation and preserve atom alias meaning. Backend selection is immutable for a run; per-turn model overrides remain supported.
ModelInfo specifies stable backend/model/deployment identity, label/reference, tri-state capabilities, modalities/tools/structured mode/reasoning, limits, dimensions and optional pricing/metadata. Unknown values are not zero or unsupported; no inference/model loading for metadata. Embedding stores ordered batch vectors, model/dimensions/optional usage.
Stream specifies consume(callback_opts) -> final ReqLLM.Response or error, ordered shared ReqLLM.StreamChunk events, cancel, idempotent close, and optional native export. Define single-consumer, callback errors, partial errors, final usage/finish reason, backpressure and cleanup responsibilities including owner death and blocked cancellation. Do not require custom adapters to construct ReqLLM.StreamResponse.
Add a deterministic custom test backend plus limited-operation variants; they construct real shared responses and record calls without ReqLLM execution/model APIs.

## Acceptance criteria
- Unit tests cover precedence, option isolation, missing callbacks, malformed results and model info.
- Shared Response contract documents fields/context/finish reasons/tool IDs/reasoning/multimodal data and missing usage.
- Stream tests prove ordering, terminal result/error, cancellation and idempotent cleanup.
- Callback contract supports generation-only and embedding-only implementations.
- No Backend.Response struct and no Nx dependency.

## Suggested commit
feat(backend): add contracts and backend dispatch

comments.text: Implemented Backend/Ref/ModelInfo/Stream/Embedding, standalone alias lookup and deterministic local/embedding-only/invalid backend contract tests. Shared ReqLLM.Response documented explicitly as backend-neutral. Stream requires backend-managed owner-death cleanup (adapter work in .3/.6). Focused tests: 13/13 passing; compile --warnings-as-errors and targeted format checks pass. New modules are not yet wired to facades/runtime; that is staged in .3-.6.

title: Add backend behavior, dispatch and portable contracts
